about: Michael Kelly Injury Lawyers works from Atlantic Avenue in the North End and says so plainly: that is its main office, and it lists further locations in Cambridge, Revere, Waltham, Arlington, Salem and Natick. Thirty people named, contingency fees, a free consultation, a 24 hour line and pages in Spanish.
2,005 reviews at 4.91, the largest count in this market by a wide margin and one of the largest in the directory. It publishes no case results we could read.

G1.evidence: Massachusetts does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Supreme Judicial Court of Massachusetts on the discipline of attorneys, on the recommendation of the Board of Bar Overseers, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 168 published discipline decisions of the Supreme Judicial Court of Massachusetts on the discipline of attorneys, on the recommendation of the Board of Bar Overseers, 1975 to 2025. 1 of them share a surname with a disciplined attorney and were read against the text of those decisions, which name somebody else. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 3 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. Massachusetts publishes no business register we can query. The Secretary of the Commonwealth's corporate search answers a request for its robots file with a 403 and its search page with a redirect loop, and the state runs no open data portal carrying the register. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 30 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 2,005 public client reviews across 3 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2023-05-29, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
